compare-reasoning-cost.title: Recover a benchmark search and compare reasoning cost
compare-reasoning-cost.start: Build the site with bun run build. The fixture opens the local Argo-Bench chart with the checked-in benchmark data and outside requests blocked.

steps.action: Open the benchmark picker and enter a query with no matches.
steps.expect: The empty result lists no options and offers Clear search.

steps.action: Clear search, browse with the arrow keys, then press Escape.
steps.expect: The benchmarks return and keyboard focus goes back to the picker.

steps.action: Choose a reasoning setting and change the budget axis to Tokens.
steps.expect: The selected effort and axis appear in the URL. The chart’s accessible label names output tokens.
The chart uses its cost axis again and the default benchmark and axis drop out of the URL.
